title: Quickly Tendered Mediterranean Chicken Salad
description: A rich and tender weeknight Mediterranean dish featuring lettuce, pressure-cooked chicken, and a variety of fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Cherry or grape tomatoes also work well

ingredients.name: Red onion
ingredients.notes: Soaked in cold water for 10 minutes to reduce pungency

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Optional, or use goat cheese or parmesan

instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Place the chicken in a pressure cooker, add 1 cup of chicken broth, and cook for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release, then chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped lettuce, sliced cucumber, diced tomatoes, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil for the dressing.
Add the chopped chicken, crumbled feta cheese, and pitted olives to the bowl with the lettuce mixture, if using.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving.
